title: Fires and Homes Surrounded in West Bank Amid Settler Activity
summary: Israeli settlers reportedly set fire to homes in the West Bank. One Palestinian individual's home was described as surrounded by Israeli settlers. The fires occurred amid a summer heat wave. NBC News spoke with a Palestinian whose home was surrounded.
summary_points: Israeli settlers reportedly set fire to homes in the West Bank.
A Palestinian individual's home was surrounded by Israeli settlers.
The fires occurred during a summer heat wave.
NBC News interviewed a Palestinian whose home was surrounded by settlers.
